范梦雪扶着苏笑笑躺到里屋的床上，给她盖好被子，又端来一碗温热的粥，一点点喂她喝下。

苏笑笑虚弱不堪，喝了小半碗粥，便又沉沉睡了过去。

范梦雪轻轻带上门，走到外屋，看到胡九郎依旧靠在椅子上，闭着双眼，眉头紧紧皱着，神色依旧凝重，似乎还在被幻境的事情困扰。

“师兄，你要不要也休息一下？你的神识还没恢复，一直硬撑着不好。”

胡九郎缓缓睁开眼睛，眼底的疲惫难以掩饰，低声道：

“我没事。苏笑笑虽然暂时脱离了危险，但体内还有残留的阴气，我们得时刻警惕，不能大意。”

范梦雪看着他，犹豫了片刻，还是忍不住开口道：

“师兄，你是不是还在想幻境里的事情？其实……你要是不想说，也没关系，但你别一直憋在心里，会影响神识恢复的。”

胡九郎沉默了片刻，眼底闪过一丝复杂的情绪，轻声道：

“我只是觉得奇怪，幻境里的画面，太过逼真了。我和杨童，不过见了两面，为什么幻境里，会是我和她相恋、被她背叛的场景？”

“或许，是阴尘阁的人，察觉到了你对杨姐姐有好感，故意用这种幻境来击溃你的心神。师兄，你别多想，那只是幻境，不是真的，杨姐姐那么好，怎么可能背叛你呢？”

胡九郎没有说话，只是轻轻点了点头。他总觉得，这幻境背后，似乎还有别的隐情，阴尘阁的目标，或许不仅仅是击溃他的心神那么简单。

夕阳西下，夜幕渐渐降临，卦铺内点起了灯，昏黄的灯光，驱散了些许阴冷的气息。

就在这时，卦铺的门被轻轻推开，杨童快步走了进来，神色有些凝重，身后没有跟着林佳。

“杨童？你怎么回来了？林佳呢？”

胡九郎立刻起身，下意识地避开了她的眼神。

“林佳还在局里整理资料，我先过来找你，有重要的事情要告诉你。我们查了阴尘阁的所有资料，也询问了黑市的一些老客，得出的结论，有些出乎我们的意料。”

“什么结论？阴尘阁和影阁，到底是什么关系？”

“我们查了很久，发现阴尘阁在黑市已经存在了几十年，一直都是做阴邪药材和法器的生意，行事隐秘，但从未与影阁有过任何关联。”

胡九郎愣住了，脸上露出一丝难以置信。

“不能把？怎么会？”

Fan Mengxue helped Su Xiaoxiao lie down on the bed in the back room, covered her with a quilt, brought her a bowl of warm porridge, and fed her little by little.

Su Xiaoxiao was so weak that after drinking less than half a bowl of porridge, she fell asleep again.

Fan Mengxue gently closed the door and walked to the outer room. She saw Hu Jiulang still leaning on the chair, his eyes closed, his brows furrowed tightly, his expression still solemn, as if he was still troubled by the fantasy.

"Senior brother, do you want to take a rest too? Your consciousness has not recovered yet, so it is not good for you to hold on."

Hu Jiulang slowly opened his eyes. The fatigue in his eyes could not be concealed, and he whispered:

"I'm fine. Although Su Xiaoxiao is temporarily out of danger, there is still residual Yin Qi in her body. We must always be vigilant and not be careless."

Fan Mengxue looked at him, hesitated for a moment, and couldn't help but said:

"Senior brother, are you still thinking about what happened in the fantasy world? Actually...if you don't want to say it, that's okay, but don't keep it in your heart, it will affect the recovery of your consciousness."

Hu Jiulang was silent for a moment, a complex emotion flashed in his eyes, and he said softly:

"I just find it strange that the scenes in the fantasy are too realistic. Yang Tong and I have only met twice. Why is there a scene in the fantasy where she and I fall in love and are betrayed by her?"

"Perhaps, the people from Yinchen Pavilion noticed that you have a crush on Sister Yang, and deliberately used this illusion to break your mind. Senior brother, don't think too much, it's just an illusion, not real. Sister Yang is so good, how could she betray you?"

Hu Jiulang didn't speak, but nodded slightly.He always felt that there seemed to be something else hidden behind this illusion. The goal of Yinchen Pavilion might not be as simple as defeating his mind.

As the sun set, night gradually fell, and lights were lit in the Gua Shop. The dim lights dissipated some of the cold atmosphere.

At this moment, the door of Gua Pu was gently pushed open, and Yang Tong walked in quickly, his expression a little solemn, and Lin Jia was not followed behind him.

"Yang Tong? Why are you back? Where is Lin Jia?"

Hu Jiulang stood up immediately and subconsciously avoided her eyes.

"Lin Jia is still sorting out information in the bureau. I'm coming to see you first. I have something important to tell you. We checked all the information in Yinchen Pavilion and also asked some regular customers in the black market. The conclusions we came to were somewhat beyond our expectations."

"What conclusion? What is the relationship between Yinchen Pavilion and Shadow Pavilion?"

"We checked for a long time and found that the Yinchen Pavilion has existed in the black market for decades. It has always been in the business of Yinxie medicinal materials and magic weapons. It acts in secret, but it has never had any connection with the Shadow Pavilion."

Hu Jiulang was stunned, with a hint of disbelief on his face.

"Can't? How come?"
